main_body: Flat ground patch of farmland: golden crop rows at top, green leafy rows in the middle, tilled brown soil furrows below, with a grass border on the left, right and bottom. It is a terrain tile block with no standing volume.
top_band: none (terrain surface; no standing object with a top band)
evidence: The candidate is a flat ground patch of crop rows and soil, not a standing object. The 3/4 top-and-front-face contract does not apply, and no receding side faces or elevation drawing is present. Terrain is judged as ground.

style.evidence: Each material has several tones. The wheat rows use pale cream, bright yellow, orange and ochre-brown speckle. The green rows use light, mid and dark greens with tinted dark-brown gaps. The soil uses several browns with lighter clods and green sprouts. The dark outlines lean brown or green with the neighbouring material, not neutral black. There are no large flat fills, and the texture is dense and per-pixel, at least as rich as the grass and paving references.
